description: Clean-runner Amiri ArabicFont capture for DT AR compiled fixture 190e32b6. Visible paint is the extractor stream with ActualText ignored. ActualText is the logical marked-content stream. Paragraph index is 0-based enumerate(environment_narrative_paragraphs), so :1 is the second environment paragraph, not a page number. Bundled Noto accepts this same model; Amiri remains a fallback, not an exemption.
